name: ingestion
description: Core's detailed document-ingestion methods, refining the harness's basic library flow: document intake (placement PR1), and l1-document-ingestion and tabular-metadata (placement PR6, bean apcg); l1-coverage, the check that an L1 extraction accounted for every normative sentence (#2405 FR-009); audio-transcription, which recogniser to run when (bean 1r0p); figure-rebuild, turning a publication's figures into computable diagrams, with the figure-coverage check.
